entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: So, the chairman's pushing me as hard[n]as ever to sell those fake stones...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I've been trying to use this as an[n]opportunity to investigate into the[n]ADP's seminars so I can expose him...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But the deeper I dig, the scarier[n]everything becomes.
How so?
What have you found?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: The ADP apparently doesn't profit very[n]much from sales of the Holy Stones.[n]It's nothing more than a front.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Most of their revenue actually comes from[n]the seminars.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: There, they give their patrons some sort[n]of mind-altering drug...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: After which, they're encouraged to donate[n]their life savings to the "benefit of the ADP."

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: People have even gone missing after[n]seminars... Families have been torn[n]apart by this madness...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: And I... I was a part of it all.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: By selling these fraudulent stones, I was[n]in direct support of their horrible actions.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I know this doesn't make up for what I've[n]done... but I want to help the others come[n]to their senses.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Barely anyone within the ADP will talk[n]to me though, and those who do won't[n]actually hear me out.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: What should I do, [lName]-san...?[n]These people are all heading down[n]a path toward great ruin...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: There has to be some way I can deal with[n]the chairman...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Right. I'll just have to admit to everything[n]that's been going on, even if I get dragged[n]down too...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: That's... the only way...
It looks like Chihaya's not sure how to[n]approach this issue...
She might do something rash at this rate...
I should take care of the chairman[n]before that happens...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'm the only one who can stop him... right?
Tell me his name.
What's Fukurai's first name?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Oh, the chairman...?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: It's [clr 2]Yuichi Fukurai[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Why do you ask...?
I can't tell you.
Don't worry about it.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: O-Oh...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Hm, how strange... It seems the cards have[n]changed somehow...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: My future is in line with that of the[n]Trickster... What does that mean...?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Even so, my fate remains unchanged.[n]I am destined to stay a monster...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Hm...
I need to take care of the chairman[n]for Chihaya...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'll have to think on this for a while.[n]Let's finish for today...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Well then, goodbye...
